BETA Close X Serco Group PLC has announced the purchase of 1,333,271 ordinary shares on September 4, 2026, as part of its ongoing share buyback program. The average price paid per share was 252.37 pence, with the lowest at 250.40 pence and the highest at 257.00 pence. Following these transactions, Serco's total issued ordinary shares, excluding treasury shares, stand at 969,101,274, with 33,644,740 ordinary shares held in treasury. The total number of voting rights is now 969,101,274. Disclaimer* Serco Group PLC 04 September 2026 04 September 2026 Legal Entity Identifier: 549300PT2CIHYN5GWJ21 Serco Group plc Transactions in own shares Serco Group plc (the " Company ") announces that, in accordance with the terms of its share buyback programme (the " Programme ") announced on 11 August 2026, it has purchased the following number of its ordinary shares of 2 pence each (" Ordinary Shares ") through RBC Europe Limited. The total number of Ordinary Shares held in treasury is 33,644,740 . The total number of voting rights in the Company, excluding treasury shares as at 04 September 2026 is 969,101,274 . This figure may be used by shareholders (and others with notification obligations) as the denominator for the calculations by which they will determine if they are required to notify their interest in, or a change to their interest in, Company or its Group under the Financial Conduct Authority's Disclosure Guidance and Transparency Rules. Since the announcement of the Programme on 11 August 2026, the Company has purchased a total of 5,194,275 Ordinary Shares, which are held in treasury.
